135: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. He came back to settle the score with someone. Anyone. EVERYONE.
647: In a remote woodland cabin, a small town doctor discovers Nell — a beautiful young hermit woman with many secrets.
Her heart. Her soul. Her language are a mystery... A mystery called Nell

A true story about finding the courage to be yourself.
1159: Once an architect, Frank Bannister now passes himself off as an exorcist of evil spirits. 1415: A widowed field mouse must move her family -- including an ailing son -- to escape a farmer's plow. Aided by a crow and a pack of superintelligent, escaped lab rats, the brave mother struggles to transplant her home to firmer ground.
Right before your eyes, and beyond your wildest dreams.
1671: When his only friend dies, a man born with dwarfism moves to rural New Jersey to live a life of solitude, only to meet a chatty hot dog vendor and a woman dealing with her own personal loss.
Loneliness is much better when you have got someone to share it with.

Sam Stone's wife has just been kidnapped... And he doesn't want her back!

This address changes all the rules.

2695: Molly Bloom, a young skier and former Olympic hopeful becomes a successful entrepreneur (and a target of an FBI investigation) when she establishes a high-stakes, international poker game.

Can a marriage survive 15 years of marriage?

Terror is the same on any planet.

A lot of kids get into trouble. These two invented it.
3719: Steven Lidz, unhappy with his home life since his mother became sick, moves in with his two eccentric uncles. As Steven grows closer to his uncles, he learns how to cope with his emotions and to value his own uniqueness.
Sometimes you find your heroes in the most unlikely places
3975: Scandal and mystery reign following the arrival of Edwina in a small Irish town populated entirely by widows. Edwina quickly falls out with the locals while also falling in with the son of the community's leader
4231: His high school teacher issues an ultimatum: turn in a science project or flunk. So Mike Harlan scavenges a military base's junk pile for a suitable gizmo. We must not destroy the world.
4487: Ethan and Sophie are a married couple on the brink of separation when, at the urging of their therapist, they decide to salvage their relationship by escaping to a beautiful vacation house for the weekend.
4743: Mrs. Bakshi is eager to find suitors for her four unmarried daughters when a family friend introduces them to handsome American Will Darcy. A Bollywood-style modern adaptation of Jane Austen's classic novel.
Bollywood meets Hollywood… And it's a perfect match
4999: Financial TV host Lee Gates and his producer Patty are put in an extreme situation when an irate investor takes over their studio.
Not every conspiracy is a theory.

If looks could kill, he wouldn't need a chainsaw.

Get ready to Laugh, to Sing, to Shout! ...For here comes Uncle Sam's Star Spangled Yankee Doodle Dandy!

I Want You. I Need You. I Love You. I Miss You.

The only one who can stop a serial killer is the man who inspired him.

7559: After the death of his girlfriend's daughter from a drug overdose, Paul Kersey takes on the local drug cartel.
7815: Abandoned by his father, a young boy is left in the hands of an unqualified childcare provider.

One's a warrior. One's a wise guy. They're two L.A. cops going after a gang of drug lords. Feet first.

Clara's wisdom. Clara's warmth. Clara's secret.

Four Friends Looking For A Little Harmony

A mystery. A cover-up. A crime. One family will risk everything for the truth.
Self - U.S. Army Special Operations Command
9607: In a beauty salon in Beirut the lives of five women cross paths. The beauty salon is a colorful and sensual microcosm where they share and entrust their hopes, fears and expectations.

Beyond the age of innocence...into the age of awareness.

When a hotshot cop and a wise-guy detective get together... the heat is on!
11143: The widow of a wise professor stumbles upon one of his inventions that's able to record and play a person's memory.
We are nothing more than the memories we keep.

What is HEAD all about? Only John Brockman's shrink knows for sure!

Breakdancing isn't dead. It's been in a coma.

Some people will do anything to get out of paying the rent...

Welcome to the American city. You buy your way in and you fight your way out. Who says it's a free country?

Electricity sparks inside of me and I'm free.
15239: A Montana bounty hunter is sent into the wilderness to track three escaped prisoners. Instead he sees something that puzzles him. Later with a female Native Indian history professor, he returns to find some answers.
A journey of the heart. The adventure of their lives.

So you want to join the internet's scariest online horror game?

No human being may touch the souls of the dead.

Us three, us brothers, us kings.

He's running for district attorney. And technically he's not a murderer.

Only two things can screw up their relationship.  He's one.  She's the other.

They've got a long way to go.

Are you a good man or a bad man?

Now Frankenstein has created a beautiful woman with the soul of the Devil!

22407: The son of an atheist, authoritarian father, believed to be liberal, wants to become a priest.

He fought for freedom to defy an empire

23175: Zoe, a strange child has a not so imaginary friend the Krampus who is the dark companion of St. Nicholas.
23431: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honor their beloved grandmother. The adventure takes a turn when the pair's old tensions resurface against the backdrop of their family history.

There are doors that should never be opened.

After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.
24199: At the end of World War II, a German soldier is looking for his daughter while an SS troop is looking for a Jewish treasure.

Self - Harlem Cultural Festival Producer & Host (archive footage)

Husbands will say sorry ... Wives will say thank you!

In a cellar, dark and deep, I lay my dearest down to sleep; A secret they would like to keep.
26503: A pair of investigators team up with a Special Forces Unit to venture deep inside a war raging between the military and a massive army of Nazi Zombie Stormtroopers. 26759: Sagar, Sam, and Aarav decide to go underwater to find the sunken ship Lady in Blue to retrieve the treasure in it to help Sameer clear his debt, but one of them has a hidden agenda.
250 feet deep lies the secret of...

Having it all comes at a price

The F.B.I.'s own tense, terrific story behind the protection of the ATOMIC BOMB!

General of the JSDF Eastern Army

It's going to take more than a miracle to save their mountain

31111: A charismatic psycho suspected of killing two innocent campers in a cold-blooded double homicide grows increasingly unstable as his suburban empire starts to crack at the foundations.
What's the worst thing you've ever done?
31623: Fauji Calling an upcoming Hindi-language film which showcases the story of a soldier who sacrifices his life in an attack and the struggle of his family after the attack. 32135: A Miami pool boy finds himself trapped in a seven-year affair with a charming older woman and her husband, the evangelical Trump stalwart Jerry Falwell Jr., as he becomes increasingly entangled with the Falwells' seemingly perfect lives.
32391: Sathya and Kiruba are friends. Sathya is reckless and gets into drinking and violent fights whereas Kiruba studies hard to become a Sub-Inspector. Tables are turned when Sathya becomes a Sub-Inspector.
32647: Rod leads a radio show dedicated to horror. Until suddenly the announcer begins to receive strange calls from a child who desperately asks for help. At first thinks that it is a bad joke until he discovers that this is not the case. These calls hide a dark secret…
Monsters are not under the bed. They are inside us.
32903: We Are Not Angels III is a Serbian film. 33159: After the death of his father, a teenage boy forms a healing friendship with a park ranger in the Yorkshire Dales.
From the heart of a boy comes the story of a man.
33415: The film wryly expresses the changes in hierarchy, caste and the power equation when water, the most important resource, vanishes and how the oppressed become the oppressors.
When there's no water, you have to play dirty.
33671: Detective Chávez, a family man and a tough cop, is put in charge of the investigation into a homicide that took place in the most exclusive circles of high society 1980s Buenos Aires. 34183: Although new friendships and new love await her, a college freshman discovers that university life is not as simple as she had hoped.
34439: Gilbert Wooley is a second-rate magician who is sent to entertain the troops in the pacific. During his time in Japan he becomes attached to a little orphan boy.
MORE THAN GREAT COMEDY HERE'S GREAT ENTERTAINMENT
34695: In the future, as a result of devastating wars, all suitable for cultivation of land turned into one big lifeless desert. He said it takes a cyborg to kill a cyborg. She's going to prove him dead wrong.
34951: George Sanders stars in this engrossing melodrama about a very domineering sister who holds a tight grip on her brother -- especially when he shows signs of falling in love.
From the Play that shocked Hollywood!
35207: Monsieur Cinema, a hundred years old, lives alone in a large villa. His memories fade away, so he engages a young woman to tell him stories about all the movies ever made.
The Star That Turns at Night
35463: The Belgian detective Hercule Poirot investigates a series of murders in London in which the victims are killed according to their initials.
It's really no mystery why this girl is MURDER... it's as simple as ABC if you look hard enough!
35719: Shesha 2016 is a gripping crime thriller set over one chaotic night at a remote police station on the Karnataka-Kerala border. When an abusive officer is brutally murdered, a lone female cop gets trapped in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a cryptic caller. It’s a gritty, fast-paced watch filled with intense suspense and dark secrets.
35975: A little girl falls into a deep borewell, and her rescue becomes a huge professional and personal challenge for a collector.
36231: Following his forced retirement from an appalling rock band, Jason decides to vacation at Brittlehouse Manor, a health farm run by the leather-gloved, ex-Nazi scientist Dr. Storm. The Operation is a Success ... When the Patient Dies
36487: Sir Arthur Blake has inherited title and lands from his brother. He also has his orphaned nephew Benjamin working for him as a bonded servant. This may enable him to return to prove his claim to being the rightful heir to the estate.
36743: The story follows Maria – a teenager whose mother used to be a hoarder. Now (set in the 90s) she lives in a foster home where a previous resident, Michael, inspires her to revisit the childhood memories and passions that she has repressed.

Ecki now has two problems – turning this bunch into a team, and facing his own fears regarding his first romance.
37255: Joseph Rouletabille, a reporter for a local newspaper, investigates the attempted killing of Mathilde Stangerson, who uses the yellow room of the title as her bedroom. At the time of the revolver shots her room was locked and the windows were barred, but when her father enters after having forced the door, there is no-one there except for Mathilde. So who did it and how did he get away?
37511: With tensions between North and South Korea, a US helicopter crashes on the North side. The survivors must work together to protect a civilian tech specialist and find their way out without the help of US military support.
37767: Conceited singer Garry Mitchell refuses to renew his radio contract, so agent Doug Blake decides to find a new personality to replace him. 38023: Leaping forward twenty years, the trilogy continues with the death of Fanny's husband, Panisse, and the discovery of her secret by her son, Césariot. The young man resolves to track down his biological father, Marius, whose life has been fraught with calamity and poverty.
38279: A few years after the Anshi Rebellion, Tang dynasty military commander Gao Shi suffers a defeat in a battle threatening Chang'an. Trapped in the besieged city, he recalls his lifelong friendship with the acclaimed poet Li Bai.
A line of poetry - A group of people - A Golden Age - An ancient culture - The Tang Dynasty - A lost world
Gao Shi Shu Tong / Gao Shi (young) (voice)
38535: Follows various residents of the Chelsea Hotel in 1966 New York City.
38791: On their way home from a high school football game, five teenage girls become hopelessly lost. Getting home by curfew is gonna be hell...
39047: While having a day-long swim at Athens’ queer beach, best friends Demosthenes and Nikitas recall the events of a recent summer in the prospect of turning them into a screenplay for Nikitas’ feature debut.
39303: The ambitious scientist Franz Walter doesn't hesitate when he is promised a professorship at the university. Based on the true story of the secret death penalty in East Germany
39559: An adventurous woman with a secret from her husband insists they go for a romantic camping trip in a remote wood to reconnect and share some quality time. Or is it just their imaginations running riot. Soon they must determine if the real threat is inside or outside their enclosure

You're Going to Learn... Even if it Kills You.

The Comedy that dreams the impossible scheme!
40327: The mayor of a small town hires a bounty hunter to find his daughter's killer, but it turns out to be a very dangerous job.
40583: A young woman accepts a job on a property with a traumatic history. Upon her arrival, she soon realizes that the nightmares of her childhood are connected to the evil in the house.
40839: The Great New Wonderful weaves five stories against the backdrop of an anxious and uncertain post-9-11 New York City.
41095: A homicidal twelve-year-old paperboy becomes obsessed with a woman and her daughter next-door, and he'll do anything to make his fantasy of the "perfect family" come alive.
Something terrifying just arrived at your doorstep...
41351: Now old, ill, poor, and largely forgotten, William Freise-Greene was once young and handsome William Green. A rich and deeply moving story of a man whose achievement opened up a new world, and of the two women whose love and sacrifices made it possible!
41607: A man goes on a mission to locate a stolen artifact for a client, which leads him to a haunted town full of vampires, sleeping beauties, and Voodoo gangsters.
Enter a town where fantasy is reality.
41863: A ruthless Southern opportunist tries to buy his cousin's land, and when thwarted, brings several tragedies to the lives of his loved ones.
They are dynamite in love and in anger!
42119: The film centers around the life of Taran, who loses her fiance Amar in a skiing accident. Her life changes when she meets Shekhar, who has seen the best and worst of times. The story explores old friendship, newfound love and a difficult decision.
Sometimes you can't let go of the past... without facing it again.
42375: Based on a true story- A group of robbers broke into a house at night with the intention of committing robbery. The house was inhabited by two young girls and a disabled child and their mother. Not getting the desired money, the robbers started torturing them. And they were raped them more than once and after the rape everyone was killed by cutting their throats.

42887: Faith, a recent divorcee, enters a dance contest to save her dance studio, where she meets Jimmy and starts rediscovering her faith and dreams.

Now, her nephew Ēriks with his wife and son, and her ex-daughter-in-law Olita with her second husband and daughter, would all love to get their hands on the car that's in the colour of Midsummer's Eve.
43399: A divorced couple fights for the custody of their three children: neither of them wants it. Mom wants to leave them to dad, and vice versa.
43655: While about to take off, Monica, the owner of a famous influencer cat named Diva, and Jack, an international thief whose dog Chichi swallowed a stolen ruby, dis- cover that their pets have gotten lost on the tarmac. 44167: Modern-day Don Juan-styled Jeanne prides herself in the destruction of men who have fallen for her charms, and reveals to a priest the murder she has committed and honestly details her past sexual encounters.

44679: Two broken, police, destruction of property by arson with an explosive charge, stealing a car. Not bad for one night! Such is the balance of Alex's eighteenth birthday - the main hero of the film.

Mad passions, madder deeds in the Edgar Allan Poe chiller!
45703: Packed off to a foster home after her father is insti­tu­tion­al­ized, a rebellious young Irish girl resolves to bust her dad out of the hospital where he's been confined.

Manipulating everyone to his vicious will, the killer taunts his victims and leads them further into the depths of the maze. After succumbing to hours of torture will anyone make it out of the maze...alive?
This is no field of dreams!

They flew. They fought. They died. They won.

46983: In an effort to dismantle their military-backed government, four men hijack an airplane, leveraging passengers onboard in the name of social change.
47239: Spirit Lake is unusually deep. No diver has ever managed to find the bottom. When Dr. Amelia Brooks disappears during a deep-water dive, her three daughters travel home. They find themselves unable to let go and become drawn into the mysteries of the lake.
Death is not what you think.
47495: Astronauts land on a planet with prehistoric creatures and a war between a human-like tribe and a race of vampires.
You'll scream yourself into a state of shock!

They've taken from the wrong mother.

A Forbidden Love That Threatened Two Kingdoms!
48519: While fulfilling her community service hours at a horse rescue ranch, Emma forms an unlikely bond with an abused show horse who won't let anyone ride him.

A film about the poor life
49799: A child who is suffering from depression due to his parents' fights is told to visit his hometown by his psychiatrist. As he spends his days there with his relatives, he starts to recover.

Can visiting atomic scientist (and expert on "cool fusion") Dr. Karel Lamonte solve the mystery before everyone disappears?
Something is eating the residents of Exceptional Vista!

50567: A mysterious stranger befriends a middle class family.
50823: It is a story of 4 different characters and their lives gets entangled in a Bank robbery by one of them and what happens with the loot.

51591: 8 shorts centered around 8 themes directed by 8 famous film directors involved and sharing their opinion on progress, on the set-backs and the challenges our planet faces today.
What do you think you are willing to do?
